clips.title: The story
paras: Along Hillsbrad's coast, Torn Fin Eyes draw the Royal Apothecary Society's attention. The Forsaken seek them for alchemical work on new plagues.

The Royal Apothecary Society puts rare biological components to use in its work on the Forsaken's New Plague. Torn Fin Eyes come from murlocs along the Western Strand of Hillsbrad Foothills. Their organic properties help activate volatile alchemical compounds. Mixed with Daggerspine naga scales, restorative troll elixirs, and gnoll-derived sludge, the eyes help stabilize and trigger toxic mixtures meant to spread death through enemy lands.
